extraction_notes: The datasheet is a family sheet (SS52 THRU SS520, Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd). SS56 takes the SS55-SS56 grouped column for maximum forward voltage (0.70 V at IF = 5.0 A), the SS52-SS56 grouped column for maximum DC reverse current (0.2 mA at 25 degC, 10 mA at 100 degC), the long-dash SS55-SS56 curve in Fig. 3, and the solid SS52-SS56 curves in Fig. 4. Column spans were confirmed visually against the table cell borders and match the Fig. 3/Fig. 4 legend groupings.

Fig. 3 y-axis labels are misprinted: two adjacent decades are both labeled 1.0 and the bottom is labeled 0.1. Pixel measurement of the 400 dpi render shows five uniformly spaced decade gridlines (231.9 px per decade), so the axis spans 100 A at the top to 0.01 A at the bottom; the digitization uses that corrected span anchored on the unambiguous 100, 10, and 1.0 labels.

Curves were digitized programmatically from a 400 dpi render: axes calibrated on labeled gridlines (Fig. 3 x: 0 V to 1.4 V linear, 149.6 px per 0.2 V; Fig. 4 x: 0% to 100% linear, 209.5 px per 20%; Fig. 4 y: 100 mA to 0.001 mA over five 185.2 px decades), thin gridlines removed by erosion, and curve crossings taken at run midpoints. Points are readings from the supplied plots, not interpolated table values. Fig. 4 y-values are converted from mA to A.

Consistency checks: digitized typical VF at 5 A is 0.64 V, below the 0.70 V table maximum; digitized 25 degC reverse current at 100% of rated VR is 4.0e-5 A, below the 2.0e-4 A table maximum; digitized 100 degC reverse current at 100% is 7.9e-3 A, below the 1.0e-2 A table maximum at 100 degC.
The reverse-current table also gives IR2 = 10 mA at VR = VDC, TA = 100 degC for SS52-SS56; the required reverse_current field records the 25 degC row.

Absolute maximum ratings for SS56 include VRRM = 60 V, VRMS = 42 V, VDC = 60 V, IF(AV) = 5.0 A at 60 Hz sine wave resistance load, IFSM = 120 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave, Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, RthJA = 60 degC/W, and RthJL = 22 degC/W. These ratings are not breakdown characterization data.
The supplied PDF identifies Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com); the top-level manufacturer preserves the exact job identity hongjiacheng.
Fig. 1 (forward current derating) and Fig. 2 (non-repetitive peak forward surge current) are rating plots, not diode IV or reverse-leakage characteristics, and were not digitized.
extraction.omission_reason: The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery time and no reverse-breakdown characterization; reverse_recovery, breakdown_voltage, and breakdown_current remain null.
